english.title: Fail to preserve records of aeroplane flight data recorder as required
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the operator of an aeroplane, namely **(..SPECIFY AEROPLANE..), failed to, at all times,

(A)_[preserve the last 25 hours of recording made by any flight data recorder which must by or under the Air Navigation Order 2016 be carried in an aeroplane]_
(B)_[preserve a record, including a means of identifying the flight to which it related, of at least one representative flight, including a take-off, climb, cruise, descent, approach to landing and landing, made within the last 12 months]_

for **(..SPECIFY PERIOD OF TIME..) as directed by the CAA
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 232 and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
